Your path to the crown

Win challenges. Earn Boost. Finish top three. Fight for the crown. · How it works

🏆
Win challenges, earn Boost — Every win earns Boost based on who you beat: stronger opponents and bigger turnouts are worth more. Beating a Spark earns 1; taking down a G.O.A.T. earns 24. Tap any Boost number to see exactly how it was earned.
🥇
Make the top 3 — The race is ranked by Boost, not win count — five easy wins won't outrank one hard one. The gold Championship Line marks who qualifies; tied Boost shares the spot, and everyone tied advances.
⚡
Championship Week — On the last day of the month, every category's top 3 are invited at once. Four days to enter, three days to vote, and on the seventh night every crown drops together at 8 PM ET.
👑
Take the title — Win Championship Night to become that category's Champion — the highest title on the platform. Leading the race is a start; the crown is won on the Night.
🌟
Hall of Fame — Titles are recorded forever. Win the same one again and it stacks — "2x Champion," "3x Champion" — and championships raise your ladder rank, from Spark all the way to G.O.A.T.
🔄
Fresh every month — The race resets on the 1st. Day-one players and veterans start level; only Hall of Fame is forever.

📜 Community Guidelines

FlamesChallenge runs on competition and trash talk. Bring the heat — just keep it about the contest, not cruelty. Here's the line.

✅ Bring it
  • Competitive trash talk — "I'll destroy you," "you're getting cooked," "easy work"
  • Confidence, callouts, rivalries, big claims
🚫 Not allowed
  • Slurs or hate speech
  • Real threats of violence or harm to anyone
  • Harassment, bullying, or targeting a person
  • Sexual or explicit content (photos, video, or text)
  • Graphic violence or gore
  • Spam, scams, or impersonation
  • Sharing someone's private info (doxxing)
🔒 Zero tolerance
  • Any sexual content involving minors. Removed immediately, account banned, and reported to the authorities.

See something that crosses the line? Tap the ⋯ on any post and hit Report — we review fast. Breaking these rules can get your content removed and your account suspended.
